name: cifiag
description: CIFIAG public website and management platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @cifiag/api" "npm run dev -w @cifiag/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @cifiag/api && npm run build -w @cifiag/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cifiag/api && npm run typecheck -w @cifiag/web
